tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sku gsung thugs rten gyi gzungs gzhug 'dod gsol bzhugs so// swasti/ pra dza bh+ya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag bsod nams 'od zer gyis thog drangs ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su bzung du gsol/ bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog ngo mtshar can 'di bzhengs pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin gdung brgyud bu slob lha sde mi sde 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas la srid mtha'i bar du gnas te 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par bdag gi sbyin pa'i bdag po bsod nams 'od zer 'khor dang bcas pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen du gyur pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su tshe 'dir dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te 'di'am 'chi kha'am bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar bdag gi don myur du mthar phyin nas gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas 'khor ba ji srid bar bstan 'gro'i don la nam yang g.yel ba med par rtse gcig brtson pa'i mthu las sems can thams cad kyis mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣan+tāthā ga to h+ya ba data/
